data.standardized_narrative: The Syndicate experienced a gross prior year reserve release of GBP 53.5 million in 2015, representing a 3.23% reduction of opening gross reserves. This favorable development was primarily driven by a benign year for catastrophe activity and a lower volume of large losses, leading to increased prior period reserve releases. Specifically, releases were noted in Catastrophe North America and Special Risk classes, as well as from low claims activity on longer-tailed classes like London Marine Liability and Aviation Products, and a lower frequency of larger losses in the Commercial Motor class.
